summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its March 2026 quarterly report, covering operational milestones such as transitioning to 24/7 titanium powder production, commissioning of the 300-ton SACMI press, and expanded customer engagements in defense and aerospace. No transaction or special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is described. The filing is a routine business update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions triggering a special-situation classification.
